when: a dragon is due in about a minute
asks: how do I set up dragon
drake's coming, what do I do
dragon soon, what now
should I get ready for drake
say: Clear your bot-side camps and reach river half a minute early, or recall now if you're low and walk in with your bot lane.
more: The team that stands in the river first gets to ward it and makes the other side walk in blind.
Camps on that side are the cheap way to be there on time: you farm, and you are already next to the pit when it spawns.
If you recall instead, you arrive a little later but with health and an item, which matters more than the first ward.
check: Are your bot and mid waves pushing, and do you have health and Smite ready?
breaks: Wrong if your bot lane is stuck under tower: then being early just gets you caught alone, so take camps or look at the top side instead.
basis: pro:Before a spawn, arrive alive and on time

when: an enemy bot laner died in the last 20 seconds and a dragon is up
asks: we just killed bot, do I take dragon
got a kill bot, drake now?
bot's dead, dragon or keep farming
kill bot lane, what do I take
say: Start dragon now while they're a player short, or shove the wave into tower first if your bot lane is too low to help.
more: A kill next to the pit is the cheapest dragon you will get: the lane that would contest it is on a death timer.
Shoving first costs a few seconds but makes their survivor choose between minions and the dragon.
If you only take the kill and walk away, the lead stays small. The dragon is what turns it into something lasting.
check: How much health do you and your laners have, and where was their jungler last seen?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler and mid are both walking down and your lane is low: take the plates or reset instead of getting collapsed on in the pit.
basis: pro:Count what the map pays for a dive or collapse

asks: can I solo dragon
should I sneak drake
nobody's bot, do I just take dragon
is it safe to solo drake right now
say: Take it alone if their jungler just showed top side and you're healthy, or wait for your bot lane to shove if he's unseen.
more: A solo dragon is slow and leaves you low, so it only works while the one player who can punish it is known to be far away.
A sighting on the far side is a short window. It runs out about as fast as he can walk back through the river.
Waiting for your lane costs time but gives you damage and a second body if someone walks in.
check: Did you actually see their jungler top side, how long ago, and is the pit warded by them?
breaks: Wrong if their mid is missing or the pit is lit up by an enemy ward: back off, clear a camp, and come back with a laner.
basis: pro:A jungler seen on the far side opens yours

when: the enemy jungler is dead and a dragon is up
asks: their jungler's dead, what do I do
enemy jungle just died, drake?
jungler dead, objective or gank
he's dead, do I take dragon
say: Start dragon right now, there's no Smite to fight you for it, or take the top pit objective instead if you're already up there.
more: With their jungler dead nobody on their team has a reliable last hit, so they usually clear waves instead of walking in.
Pick the objective you are closest to. Walking across the map can burn most of his death timer.
Dropping a chase for the objective feels slow, but it is the part of the kill that stays on the scoreboard.
check: Is the objective alive, and is his respawn timer longer than the time you need to kill it?
breaks: Wrong if his timer is nearly up and you're low: he comes back fresh with Smite, so take the nearest camps and set up for the next spawn instead.
basis: pro:A dead jungler makes the objective free

when: the enemy mid laner died in the last 20 seconds and an objective is up
asks: their mid just died, do we do something
mid's dead, drake?
enemy mid dead what can I take
we killed mid, grubs or dragon
say: Start the nearest objective now, their mid can't rotate, or invade the camps on that side if nothing is up yet.
more: Mid is the lane that reaches either river first. With it dead or sent home, the river belongs to you for a short while.
Their side lanes can see it happen and still not arrive in time without giving up waves.
If nothing has spawned, the same window pays in their jungle camps or deep wards for the next spawn.
check: Is a dragon or the top pit objective alive, and where was their jungler last seen?
breaks: Wrong if your own mid is also dead or recalling: the river is even again, so only start it with a side lane next to you.
basis: pro:A low or dead enemy mid makes the river yours

when: you are level 6 and the enemy jungler is level 5, with a dragon up or due soon
asks: I hit six first, what do I do with it
I'm six and he's not, drake?
got my ult before their jungler, now what
level lead, should I force dragon
say: Force the dragon now while you have an ultimate and he doesn't, or gank the lane beside it first if it's not up yet.
more: An ultimate against no ultimate is the biggest early gap between junglers, and it closes the moment he finishes a camp or two.
Starting the dragon makes him choose: walk into a fight a level down or give it.
If you wait for a perfect setup, he gets his level and the edge is gone.
check: Is your ultimate actually up, and are your nearby laners level 6 or close to it too?
breaks: Wrong if their mid and bot have their ultimates and yours don't: the lanes decide it then, so take the gank or their camps instead.
basis: pro:Do not fight an objective one spike behind

when: your team or theirs killed a dragon about four minutes ago
asks: when's the next dragon
next drake soon, how do I path
dragon's about to respawn right
how do I plan for the second dragon
say: Dragon returns five minutes after it died, so clear toward bot side now, or recall first if you're holding an item's worth of gold.
more: The respawn is fixed, which means you can plan the clear before it: start far, finish near the pit.
A recall a minute out is fine. A recall with twenty seconds left hands them the river.
If your camps on that side are down, take vision or a gank bot instead of farming the far side.
check: Which of your camps are up, and how much gold are you holding?
breaks: Wrong if your team cannot fight for it at all: skip the setup, farm the far side, and plan to take something top when they start it.
basis: rule

when: your team has more kills but the enemy carries are farming, and a dragon is due
asks: we're winning early, what do I do with it
they outscale, how do I close
we're ahead but they're scaling, plan?
should I just keep ganking
say: Put the lead into dragons so they have to fight you early, or take towers with herald if they simply refuse to show.
more: A scaling team wants a quiet game. Every dragon you stack is a reason they cannot have one.
Kills alone fade as their items arrive. Dragons and towers do not fade.
By the third dragon they must contest on your terms or accept that soul is coming.
check: How many dragons does each team have, and are your waves pushed before you start?
breaks: Wrong if your lead is one fed laner and the rest are behind: play around that laner's side and its towers rather than five-man pit fights.
basis: pro:Early dragons are the clock against a scaling team

when: your team has three dragons
asks: we're on soul point, how do I set up
one more dragon for soul, what do I do
soul drake's next, plan?
how do we get soul
say: Treat this dragon as the game: reset together a minute early and take river first, or pull them off with a side wave if you're weaker.
more: Four elemental dragons give soul, so this is the one they will send everybody to stop.
Being there first with wards means they walk through dark jungle into you, which is the fight you want.
There is no need to gamble it. If the setup is bad, back off and take it after a pick.
check: Is everyone alive with items bought, and which side waves are pushing?
breaks: Wrong if a carry is dead or still in base at the spawn: hold the river and wait for them rather than starting it four against five.
basis: pro:A lead is not power until it is spent

asks: where do I ward for dragon
how do I get vision for the objective
what do I do with my wards before drake
should I sweep the pit
say: Sweep the pit and ward their jungle entrances with your support before it spawns, or just ward your own side if you're the weaker team.
more: Wards on their entrances show you the collapse coming. Clearing theirs means they cannot see whether you started.
Going deep alone is how junglers die thirty seconds before the objective. Go with a second player or stay shallow.
Defensive wards on your own side still tell you whether a contest is possible.
check: Do you have a control ward and a sweeper, and is your support moving with you?
breaks: Wrong if nobody can come with you: skip the deep ward and keep your life, because a dead jungler loses the objective outright.
basis: pro:Before a spawn, arrive alive and on time

when: an objective is due in more than a minute and you hold enough gold for an item
asks: do I back before dragon
should I recall or stay for the objective
I've got gold, base or stay
is there time to buy before baron
say: Recall right now and come back with the item, or stay only if their jungler is dead and you can start it immediately.
more: Gold in your pocket does nothing in a smite fight. The item does.
Over a minute out there is time to buy and walk back. Under that, the recall itself gives them the river.
If the enemy bought and you did not, you fight the objective on old items against new ones.
check: How much gold do you have, and how long until the objective spawns?
breaks: Wrong if the spawn is seconds away: stay, keep your position, and buy after the objective is decided.
basis: pro:Skipping the recall keeps camp pace but not power

when: you are below half health and an objective is due within a minute
asks: I'm low, do I still go to dragon
half health, contest or back
can I fight for it this low
should I reset before the objective
say: Recall now if you can be back before it spawns, or stay back and just threaten the Smite if there's no time.
more: A low jungler near the pit is the first target, and once you die the objective goes with you.
Even a late arrival at full health is worth more than an early one that has to hide.
If there is no time, your job shrinks to one thing: stay alive in range to Smite.
check: How long until it spawns, and are your teammates healthy enough to hold the river without you?
breaks: Wrong if your team is already fighting four against five without you: then go in at once, because waiting only loses it slower.
basis: pro:Before a spawn, arrive alive and on time

when: the enemy jungler's item list just changed and an objective is up
asks: their jungler just backed, can I do something
he's in base, drake?
enemy jungle recalled, what's the play
he just bought, is this a window
say: He's just been in base, so start the objective now if your lanes can join, or take his nearest camps if they can't.
more: New items mean he was in the fountain a moment ago, so for a short while he is the furthest player from the pit.
It is a short edge. He comes back stronger than he left, so finish before he arrives or leave.
Camps are the smaller prize, but they need no help and cost him his next clear.
check: Is the objective alive, and can you kill it before he walks back?
breaks: Wrong if you are low or slow on the monster: he returns with an item while you are half health in the pit, so ward and reset instead.
basis: pro:Their jungler or carry in base is your window

when: the enemy top laner has Teleport and yours does not, with an objective due
asks: they have TP and we don't, do we still fight
their top has teleport, how do I play dragon
what about their teleport
TP disadvantage at the objective
say: Start it fast before Teleport can matter, or don't start at all and take something on their top laner's side instead.
more: Teleport means their fifth player can appear behind you while yours is still walking.
A quick start with numbers already there gives it no time. A slow, even standoff is exactly when it lands.
If their top does teleport, his lane is open, so your top should be taking the tower.
check: Is their Teleport up, how fast can you kill the objective, and is your top able to push?
breaks: Wrong if their top is dead or just used Teleport to get back to lane: then you have the numbers, so take your time and set up properly.
basis: pro:Teleport decides who has the extra player

asks: they're coming, do I finish or fight
do we turn or keep hitting dragon
fight at the pit, what do I do
finish baron or turn
say: Call one thing: finish it if it's nearly dead and Smite's up, or everyone turns and fights if it still has lots of health.
more: Half the team hitting the monster and half fighting loses both: not enough damage on either.
A low objective is worth a couple more seconds. A healthy one just pins you in a small space while they hit you.
Winning the fight usually gets you the objective afterwards anyway, and often the next one too.
check: Is a fight really starting, how low is the objective, is your Smite ready, and where are your carries standing?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is already in the pit with you: do not race him on a half-health monster, kill or zone him first.
basis: pro:One call at an objective: finish it or fight

asks: how do I win the smite
how do I not lose the smite fight
I keep losing fifty-fifties
tips for smiting dragon
say: Keep their jungler out of the pit so only you can Smite, or burst it down with abilities and Smite together if he gets in.
more: A smite fight you have to win on reaction is a coin toss. One where he cannot reach the monster is not.
Ask your team to slow the damage near the end so the health does not skip past your Smite.
Your biggest damage ability landing with Smite widens the range you can secure from.
check: Is your Smite up, and where is their jungler standing compared with the pit?
breaks: Wrong if he is already beside the monster and tankier than you: stop hitting it and fight him first, then come back to it.
basis: pro:If you cannot win the Smite duel, remove their jungler

when: the enemy jungler is Nunu & Willump or Cho'Gath
asks: how do I smite against Nunu
Cho's going to steal it isn't he
their jungler out-smites me, what do I do
can I beat his smite
say: Don't race him: lock him down or zone him before it gets low, or take it only while he's dead or across the map.
more: Both have an ability that hits a monster very hard on top of Smite, so an even race favours them.
The answer is to make it not a race. Crowd control on him as the objective gets low removes his button.
Otherwise pick your moments: his death timer or a sighting on the far side.
check: Where is he right now, and does your team have crowd control saved for him?
breaks: Wrong if he is far behind and your team kills the objective much faster: then just burn it quickly before he can get near.
basis: pro:If you cannot win the Smite duel, remove their jungler

asks: how do I secure objectives as Nunu
Nunu smite tips
can I just take dragon as Nunu
should I contest as Nunu
say: Bite with Consume and Smite together to secure it, or roll in for a steal with the same combo if they've started it.
more: Consume damages monsters, so you have two hard hits where most junglers have one.
That makes contested objectives better for you than for almost anyone. You can afford to show up late.
Snowball Barrage roots large monsters and champions it hit, which helps hold their jungler off the pit.
check: Are Consume and Smite both ready, and can you reach the pit alive?
breaks: Wrong if you walk in alone with Consume down: wait the cooldown out of sight, or give this one and set up the next.
basis: kit:Nunu & Willump

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: how do I secure dragon as Cho
Cho'Gath smite fight
do I use my ult on the objective
Feast on baron or on a champion
say: Feast and Smite the objective together to secure it, or keep Feast for their carry if no enemy jungler is near.
more: Feast deals heavy true damage to a unit, so with Smite it finishes an objective from higher than their jungler expects.
Killing with Feast also grows you, so a secured objective makes you tankier for the fight after.
The cost is that Feast is then down for the fight, so choose which one matters more.
check: Are Feast and Smite both up, and is their jungler close enough to contest?
breaks: Wrong if the fight is the real danger and the objective is uncontested: Smite alone is enough, and Feast should go on a champion.
basis: kit:Cho'Gath

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: how do I use Kindred ult at objectives
Kindred at dragon, what do I do
can I save the dragon with my ult
Lamb's Respite on baron?
say: Hold Lamb's Respite for the pit: drop it to keep your team alive through their burst, or to stop the objective dying to their Smite.
more: Nothing inside the zone can die while it lasts, and that includes whatever is standing in the pit.
Used on your team it buys the seconds your damage needs. Used on a low objective it can ruin their timing.
It heals everyone inside at the end, enemies too, so place it where mostly your side stands.
check: Is your ultimate up, and who is standing inside the area where you would place it?
breaks: Wrong if their whole team is in the zone and yours is not: you would be saving them, so keep it and kite back instead.
basis: kit:Kindred

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: how do I use Nocturne ult for objectives
Paranoia at dragon?
when do I ult around baron
Nocturne objective setup
say: Use Paranoia as you start it so they can't see each other's vision, or save it to dive their carry if they're already there.
more: Paranoia cuts every enemy's sight and removes their shared vision, so a started objective is much harder to check.
It also stops them seeing where your team is standing as they walk in.
Used that way you lose the dive for this fight, so only spend it when the objective is the goal.
check: Is the pit already warded by them, and is their jungler close enough to walk in anyway?
breaks: Wrong if they are already standing at the pit: darkness does not move them, so keep it for jumping the carry when the fight starts.
basis: kit:Nocturne

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Karthus at objectives, what do I do
when do I ult for a dragon fight
should I hold Requiem for the objective
Karthus ult across the map
say: Stand in the fight with Defile on and ult once they're low, or press Requiem from anywhere if the fight is across the map.
more: Requiem hits every enemy champion wherever they are, so you influence an objective fight you cannot reach.
Death Defied lets you keep casting after you die, so being in the middle of a pit fight is fine for you.
It has a channel, so cast it from somewhere nobody can interrupt you.
check: Is Requiem up, and are several enemies low enough for it to matter?
breaks: Wrong if they are all healthy and the objective is the real race: Requiem will not secure a monster, so walk there and Smite.
basis: kit:Karthus

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: how do I play objectives as Fiddle
Fiddlesticks at dragon
where do I ult from at baron
do I start it or wait as Fiddle
say: Let them start it and Crowstorm in from the dark once they're clumped, or start it yourself only when their jungler is dead.
more: A team hitting an objective is packed into a small space, which is the best possible Crowstorm.
Your effigies replace your trinket, so use them to watch the entrances and to make them unsure where you are.
If you are the one in the pit, they know where you are and your biggest threat is gone.
check: Is Crowstorm up, and is there an unwarded spot near the pit to channel from?
breaks: Wrong if they have swept and warded every approach: you will be seen channeling, so stay with your team and fight front to back.
basis: kit:Fiddlesticks

asks: Ivern at objectives, how
can Ivern even take dragon
what do I do with Daisy at the objective
Ivern smite fight
say: Bring Daisy and your laners to the pit and shield whoever tanks it, or give it if you'd be starting it alone.
more: You cannot hit normal camps, but epic monsters are fair game. You just lack damage on your own.
Daisy adds a body and damage, and Triggerseed on the player tanking makes the take much safer.
Rootcaller on their jungler as he walks in is your version of winning the smite fight.
check: Is Daisy up, and which teammates are actually near the pit with you?
breaks: Wrong if your lanes cannot leave: an Ivern alone on a dragon is slow and exposed, so ward it and keep your camps growing instead.
basis: kit:Ivern

asks: should I take objectives as Bel'Veth
Bel'Veth dragon or farm
do objectives help my stacks
what do I prioritise as Bel'Veth
say: Take every objective that's free, big monsters feed your stacks, or keep to camps and skirmishes if their team can contest it.
more: Your passive grows from large monsters and champion takedowns, so an uncontested objective is progress toward your form as well as a buff.
Forty stacks give a ninety second True Form and eighty make it permanent, so early stacking speed sets your whole game.
A lost pit fight costs you tempo you need for those stacks, so be picky about contested ones.
check: How many stacks do you have, and who can reach the pit before you finish?
breaks: Wrong if you are far behind on items: a contested objective just gets you killed, so farm to your next item and take the next one.
basis: kit:Bel'Veth

asks: I'm a tank, how do I play the objective
do I start dragon or engage
when do I go in at the pit
tank jungle at baron
say: Let them start it and engage once they're packed in the pit, or start it yourself to bait them through a choke.
more: A team hitting a monster is clumped and facing the wrong way, which is what an engage champion wants.
Starting it yourself works too: they have to walk through narrow entrances into you.
Either way, the plan is the fight first and the objective second.
check: Is your engage ability up, and are your damage dealers close enough to follow?
breaks: Wrong if your carries are far behind you: an engage with no follow-up just loses you, so stay next to them and peel instead.
basis: pro:Who starts the objective depends on who wants to be pinned

when: your team has long-range poke and theirs has hard engage
asks: we're a poke comp, how do we do dragon
they have engage, do I start it
how do I play the objective against a dive team
should we just rush it
say: Get there first and poke from outside the pit, don't start it, or burn it fast only once their engager is low or dead.
more: If you start it, your team stands clumped in a pit and their engage lands on all of you.
Arriving first lets your poke work before any fight, and a team at half health cannot walk in.
Once their main engager is chunked or dead, the objective is safe to take quickly.
check: Who is at the pit first, and is their engage champion healthy with Flash?
breaks: Wrong if they arrived first and hold the pit with wards behind them: you are the one walking into them, so trade elsewhere.
basis: pro:Who starts the objective depends on who wants to be pinned

when: between 7:00 and 8:00
asks: grubs are coming, what do I do
how do I set up grubs
should I path top for grubs
grubs at eight right
say: Finish your clear top side so you're there at eight minutes, or stay bot and plan for dragon if your top lane is losing.
more: Grubs are a single early window and never come back, so the choice is made by where your clear ends.
They need a top or mid laner to join, or they take too long and you get caught.
If top cannot move, spending the same minute on dragon side is an even answer.
check: Is your top lane's wave pushed, and is your mid able to move first?
breaks: Wrong if both your top and mid are pinned under tower: you would be alone in the top river, so take the bot side instead.
basis: rule

when: after 8:00, an enemy top or mid laner died in the last 20 seconds, and grubs are still up
asks: top just got a kill, grubs?
their top's dead, what do I take
we killed top lane, now what
do I take grubs after that kill
say: Take grubs with your laner now while they're a player short top side, or help crash the wave for plates if grubs are gone.
more: A dead top or mid laner is exactly the player who would contest that pit.
Grubs make your team better at taking towers, so they pay most when your lanes can push afterwards.
Plates are the alternative, and they are gold right now rather than later.
check: Are grubs still alive, and how healthy is the laner coming with you?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is alive and nearby while your laner is low: take the plates from range or reset, not a slow pit.
basis: pro:Price grubs against plates and waves

when: the grubs have been taken or their window has passed
asks: grubs are done, what's next
what's the next objective
herald or dragon now
what do I path toward after grubs
say: Herald takes that top pit next, so plan one clear toward it, or stay bot side if a dragon comes up first.
more: The top pit goes grubs, then herald, then baron from twenty minutes, so there is always a next thing to path toward.
Herald is a tower-taking tool, so it is worth most when a tower is already damaged.
If dragon and herald overlap, take the one where your lanes can move.
check: Which objective spawns first, and which of your lanes can leave their wave?
breaks: Wrong if your team is far behind: neither is free, so pick the one their jungler is not standing at and give the other.
basis: rule

when: your team just killed the herald
asks: where do I use herald
I've got herald, which lane
drop herald mid or side
when do I use the herald
say: Drop it mid just before the next dragon to pull them off the river, or use it now on a side tower that's already low.
more: Herald mid does two jobs: it damages the tower and it forces someone to stay and answer it while dragon spawns.
On a side lane it is plain gold, best where your laner is ahead and the tower is nearly down.
Held too long it is wasted, so choose within a clear or two.
check: Is there a wave to walk it in with, and can they kill it before it charges?
breaks: Wrong if their whole team is waiting mid: it dies for nothing, so take it to the side lane they left.
basis: pro:Herald in mid before a dragon buys the river

when: an enemy outer tower is still standing near the next objective
asks: what do we do before the next dragon
tower or objective first
should we take mid tower
how do I open up the map
say: Take the outer tower nearest the next objective first, or just ward that side deep if the tower won't fall in time.
more: Their towers protect the paths into the pit. With one gone, they have to walk through dark space to reach it.
It also gives your own team a safer route in and out.
A minute spent on that tower often decides the objective before anyone fights.
check: Which outer towers are down, and how long until the objective spawns?
breaks: Wrong if sieging would make you late: stop hitting the tower and get to the river on time.
basis: pro:Outer towers are vision

when: between 19:00 and 20:00
asks: baron's spawning soon, what do I do
how do I set up baron
twenty minutes, baron?
what changes at baron spawn
say: Get side waves pushing and put vision on the top river before twenty minutes, or keep taking dragons if you can't hold that side.
more: Baron shares the pit herald used, so the top river becomes the dangerous side of the map from twenty minutes.
Waves pushing in make them answer lanes or the pit, and they cannot do both.
You do not have to take it at spawn. Owning the area is enough to stop them sneaking it.
check: Where are the side waves, and does your team have control wards for the pit?
breaks: Wrong if you are behind and they already hold the top river: do not walk in to ward, clear waves and watch for a pick instead.
basis: pro:Push the side waves before you posture at Baron

when: after 20:00 and two or more enemies are dead
asks: we got two kills, baron?
should we do baron now
they're down two, what do we take
is this a baron call
say: Start Baron now if their jungler is one of the dead, or take a tower instead if he's alive and you're low.
more: Baron needs time, so compare it with their death timers before the first hit.
Without their jungler there is no Smite to fear, and three players rarely walk into five.
With him alive, a low team in the pit is a steal waiting to happen, and a tower is certain.
check: How long are their death timers, how healthy is your team, and is your Smite up?
breaks: Wrong if the timers are short and your damage dealers are the ones who died: reset and push waves, and set Baron up properly afterwards.
basis: pro:A dead jungler makes the objective free

when: after 20:00, your team is clearly ahead and the enemy jungler is alive
asks: we're ahead, should we just do baron
do we rush baron
they're all alive, baron or no
is baron safe right now
say: Tap Baron to make them walk in, then turn and fight, or leave it and take the towers they abandoned to come.
more: When you are ahead, a smite contest is the one way they get back in. Do not offer it.
Starting it pulls them through dark jungle toward you, and you choose when to stop hitting.
Finish it after the fight is won or after a pick.
check: Is the pit warded, where is their jungler, and is anyone on your team standing alone?
breaks: Wrong if your team cannot disengage from the monster quickly: do not start it at all, hold vision and wait for them to make a mistake.
basis: pro:With a lead, Baron is bait before it is a prize

when: after 20:00
asks: can we sneak baron
nobody's looking, baron?
should I call a sneaky baron
they're all bot, do we baron
say: Sneak it only if you saw most of them far away and your team kills it fast, or just ward it and catch whoever checks.
more: A sneak works on distance and speed. If either is missing, it becomes a fight where you are already low.
Sweep the pit first. One enemy ward turns a sneak into an invitation.
The safer version is to look like you started it and ambush the first player who comes.
check: How many enemies did you just see and where, and did you sweep the pit?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is unseen: assume he is near, back off the monster and take the side they showed on.

basis: pro:Outer towers are vision

when: after 20:00 and no enemy has been involved in a kill or objective for a while
asks: nobody's showing, are they on baron
where are they, baron?
should I check baron
they all disappeared
say: Check Baron with a ward or a ranged ability from over the wall, or push a side wave to make them show.
more: Five players missing late with Baron alive usually means the pit or a bush near it.
Walking in to look is how the jungler dies and Baron goes for free.
A wave pushing into their base forces someone to appear without you risking anything.
check: Do you have a ward or a sweep available, and who on your team can scout from range?
breaks: Wrong if you can hear or see Baron being hit and your team is close: then go together at once, do not keep scouting.
basis: pro:With a lead, Baron is bait before it is a prize

when: two or more allies died in the last 30 seconds near an objective
asks: we lost the fight, do I try to steal
team's dead, what do I do
they won the fight and they're taking it
I'm the only one alive
say: Leave and clear the waves coming at your towers, or try the Smite only if it's Baron, soul or Elder and you have Flash.
more: After a lost fight they take the objective anyway. What you control is whether they also take towers.
A surviving jungler who clears waves keeps the base whole until the team respawns.
A steal is the one thing that undoes the fight, which is why it is worth it on the big ones only.
check: How long are your team's timers, and where are the minion waves?
breaks: Wrong if they are too low to finish the objective and are leaving: then take it yourself once they are gone.
basis: pro:After a won fight, the waves decide whether you got paid

when: the enemy jungler is two or more levels ahead of you
asks: their jungler's way ahead, do I contest
he's fed, can I fight for dragon
I'm behind in jungle, objective?
he out-levels me
say: Let your team's numbers decide it, go only as a group, or give it and farm the opposite side.
more: Alone in the river against a jungler that far ahead, you lose the duel and the Smite.
As five it matters less. He is one player and can be controlled.
The camps on the far side while he does it are how the gap starts to close.
check: Are your laners ahead or behind, and can they reach the pit before you?
breaks: Wrong if your laners are winning hard: let them start the fight and stay back with Smite ready, since you only need the last hit.
basis: pro:A jungler who is behind has few places to go

when: your team is behind in kills and towers and an objective is due within a minute
asks: we're behind, how do we even get dragon
can't fight them straight up
any way to contest when we're weaker
we lose the five v five
say: Send one player to shove the far side wave so they fight a carry short, or give it if nobody answers the wave.
more: A pushed wave makes one of them choose between losing a tower and joining late.
For a while the pit is four against four, and that is a fight a weaker team can take.
Your part is to be ready to start or Smite in exactly that window.
check: Is there a side wave to push, which enemy went to answer it, and how far is he from the pit?
breaks: Wrong if they ignore the wave and all five stay: your pusher should take the tower, and you should not start the fight.
basis: pro:A pushed side wave pulls a carry away from the pit

when: an objective is due within a minute and you see a risky gank or invade
asks: can I gank before dragon
one more play before the objective?
there's a kill here, do I go
should I invade before drake
say: Skip it and be at the pit on time with full health, or take it only if the kill is certain and beside the objective.
more: A death or a low health bar right before the spawn costs the objective, which is worth more than the kill.
A kill next to the pit helps the objective. A kill across the map makes you late for it.
The boring choice here is the one that wins the Smite.
check: How long until the spawn, and how sure is the kill really?
breaks: Wrong if the objective is one your team has already decided to give: then the gank on the far side is exactly right.
basis: pro:Before a spawn, arrive alive and on time

when: an enemy destroyed one of your inhibitors in the last few minutes and Baron or Elder is up
asks: inhib's down, do we go baron
can we leave base for the objective
super minions and baron's up
do I defend base or contest
say: Clear the super wave first and then move as five, or send only yourself for the Smite if the wave can't be left.
more: Leaving with super minions at your base means you can win the objective and lose the game.
A cleared wave buys a short window. Use it together and come straight back.
If it cannot be left, a single Smite attempt costs one player instead of the base.
check: How close is the super wave to your towers, and who clears it fastest?
breaks: Wrong if the lane has just been pushed out past the river: then everyone can go, and quickly.
basis: written

when: no dragon has been killed yet
asks: I'm a farming jungler, do I go first dragon
should I skip drake and just farm
do I have to fight for first dragon
power farming, give dragon?
say: Give the first one if it costs you a full clear, or take it when it's free because their jungler showed top.
more: Your champion gets stronger from camps, so an early river fight is played on their terms, before your items.
One conceded dragon is cheap. What matters is that you are full build sooner and ready by the one that sets up soul point.
Free is different: if nobody can contest, the dragon costs you about one camp's worth of time.
check: Where did their jungler last show, and which of your camps are up?
breaks: Wrong if this would be their third dragon: farming through that one hands them soul point, so the team has to show up.
basis: pro:Give early dragons, then fight the one before soul point

when: you have two or more kills or assists before 8:00 and a dragon is up
asks: I'm ahead early, dragon or keep ganking
got two kills, what now
do I take drake with this lead
I'm fed early, what do I do with it
say: Spend the lead on dragon now while you out-fight their jungler, or gank bot once more first if that lane is still healthy.
more: An early ganking champion is strongest in these minutes, and that edge shrinks every clear the other jungler finishes.
A dragon turns kills into something that stays. More kills with nothing taken can still leave the game even later.
Ganking bot first is not a detour: a dead or low bot lane is what makes the dragon free.
check: How healthy are you and your bot lane, and where did their jungler last show?
breaks: Wrong if you are holding gold for an item: recall and buy first, because the lead only counts once it is spent.
basis: written

asks: I'm an assassin, what do I do at dragon
where do I stand for the objective fight
assassin jungle at the pit, how
do I go in the pit or flank
say: Wait off to the side and jump their carry as they walk in, or stay with your team and hold Smite if they come grouped.
more: Inside the pit you are a squishy champion standing still, which wastes what your kit is for.
A carry killed on the way in turns the objective into a numbers fight before it starts.
The cost is distance from the monster, so if nobody walks alone, get back in Smite range before it is low.
check: Is the side you want to wait on unwarded, and is your Smite up?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is already at the pit: the Smite matters more than the kill, so stay close enough to press it.
basis: written

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Lee Sin at dragon, what do I do
do I kick their jungler
how do I win smite as Lee
Lee Sin objective fight
say: Kick their jungler out of the pit with Dragon's Rage when it's low, then Smite, or kick their carry into your team if he's not near.
more: Dragon's Rage launches its target back, so the one player who can out-Smite you is suddenly out of range.
Wait until the monster is low. Kick too early and he simply walks back in before the Smite matters.
Kicking a carry into your team instead starts the fight, so only do that when the objective is not about to be decided.
check: Is Dragon's Rage up, and is their jungler standing where a kick sends him away from the monster, not over it?
breaks: Wrong if kicking him moves him closer to the objective: hold it, and use Safeguard to a teammate to stay alive for the Smite.
basis: kit:Lee Sin

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Jarvan at the objective, how
who do I ult at dragon
J4 at baron, what do I do
do I Cataclysm their jungler
say: Cataclysm their jungler outside the pit so he can't reach it, or drop it on their carry if your team's damage can follow.
more: Cataclysm builds an arena around the target, so a jungler caught away from the monster has to get out before he can Smite.
On a carry it is an engage, good when they walk through a narrow entrance toward you.
Your flag and Dragon Strike get you there, so keep them for the moment you commit.
check: Is Cataclysm up, is your own Smite in range of the monster, and does their jungler have Flash or a dash to leave the arena?
breaks: Wrong if the jump takes you out of Smite range of a low objective: Smite first, then use it to start the fight after.
basis: kit:Jarvan IV

asks: Trundle at dragon, how do I use pillar
how do I stop their jungler as Trundle
Trundle objective tips
where do I put pillar at baron
say: Drop Pillar of Ice in the entrance as it gets low to block their jungler, or save it to split their carry off in a fight.
more: The pillar is terrain nobody can walk through, and it slows everyone near it, so one cast can keep their Smite out of range.
Frozen Domain under the monster speeds you up while your team finishes it.
If the fight comes first, the pillar is better spent splitting one player off from the rest.
check: Which entrance is their jungler coming through, and is Pillar of Ice ready?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler can jump walls or is already inside: the pillar will not stop him, so fight him before the objective gets low.
basis: kit:Trundle

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Amumu at the objective, what do I do
when do I ult at dragon
do I start it or engage as Amumu
Amumu baron fight
say: Let them start it, then Bandage Toss in and use Curse of the Sad Mummy on the clump, or start it yourself if their jungler's dead.
more: A team hitting a monster stands close together, and your ultimate stuns everyone around you.
Bandage Toss is how you get there, so do not throw it early to poke.
Starting it yourself puts your team in the clump instead, which is only fine when nobody can punish it.
check: Is your ultimate up, are their carries standing together, and is your team close enough to follow?
breaks: Wrong if your damage dealers are not with you: a stun nobody follows only gets you killed, so stay with them and protect the Smite.
basis: kit:Amumu

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Evelynn at dragon, what do I do
how do I play objectives as Eve
do I stand with my team as Evelynn
Eve before baron
say: Wait near the pit in camouflage and charm whoever arrives alone, or sit back for the Smite if they come as five.
more: Demon Shade hides you from level 6, so the minute before a spawn is when you find a pick.
Allure needs time on the target before it charms, so mark someone early as they walk in.
A kill before the spawn makes the objective a numbers fight, which suits you far better than standing in a pit.
check: Is there an enemy control ward near where you would wait, and is your Smite up?
breaks: Wrong if they walk in together with vision: you cannot fight front to back, so stay behind your team and play only for the Smite.
basis: kit:Evelynn

asks: Zac at the objective, how
do I jump in at dragon as Zac
where do I engage from at baron
Zac objective fight
say: Slingshot in from out of sight once they're hitting it, or start it yourself and turn when they walk through the entrance.
more: Elastic Slingshot lets you start a fight from far enough away that they do not see you coming.
At level 6, Let's Bounce on a team packed around a monster knocks up several of them at once.
Cell Division means going in first is less costly for you than for most, if your team can protect the bloblets.
check: Is there an unwarded spot to charge from, and are your damage dealers close enough to follow?
breaks: Wrong if your team is far behind you: you land alone in five players, so stay with them and use the jump to answer their engage.
basis: kit:Zac

when: you are level 6 or higher
asks: Taliyah at dragon, what do I do with my wall
do I wall the pit
Taliyah objective setup
when do I ult for baron
say: Wall off the pit with Weaver's Wall as it gets low so their jungler can't walk in, or use it to get there first.
more: The wall is very long, so it can close the side of the pit their team is coming from.
Used earlier, it is travel: you reach the river before their jungler and get the first wards down.
You only have one, so decide before the spawn whether this objective needs you early or needs the block.
check: Is Weaver's Wall up, and which side is their team coming from?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler is already inside the pit: the wall locks him in with the monster, so use Seismic Shove to throw him out instead.
basis: kit:Taliyah

asks: can I solo dragon as Warwick
Warwick drake alone?
do I need help for dragon as WW
should I sneak dragon as Warwick
say: You can take it alone, your attacks heal you once you're low, or wait for a laner if their jungler hasn't shown.
more: Eternal Hunger heals you from your own attacks below half health, and more when very low, so the dragon hurts you less than most junglers.
The risk is not the monster. It is someone walking in while you are low and in a pit.
With a laner beside you it is faster, and you have a second body if it gets contested.
check: Where did their jungler last show, and is the pit warded by them?
breaks: Wrong if their bot lane has the wave pushed and full health: they walk in on you, so clear camps and come back when your lane can move.
basis: kit:Warwick

when: your top laner has Teleport and theirs does not, with an objective due
asks: we have TP and they don't, do we fight
my top has teleport, contest?
TP advantage, what do I do
can top teleport to dragon
say: Fight for it, your top can Teleport in as the extra player, or stall first if his Teleport isn't back yet.
more: Their top has to walk, so for a while the fight is five against four on your side.
Wards are what he teleports to, so getting vision down early does two jobs.
If the spell is still on cooldown the edge is not there yet, and waiting costs you little if you hold the river.
check: Is his Teleport actually up, and is there a ward or minion near the pit for him to use?
breaks: Wrong if your top is losing lane hard: leaving costs him a tower, so treat it as four against four and decide on that.
basis: pro:Teleport decides who has the extra player

when: your team has two dragons and the enemy has one or none
asks: we've got two dragons, what now
how do I get to soul point
third dragon, how do I set it up
we're ahead on dragons, plan?
say: Set this one up early: push mid and bot and be at the river first, or take the nearest tower if you'd arrive second.
more: The third dragon puts you on soul point, and from then on they have to contest every one.
They know that, so expect all five. Being first with wards is what makes it your fight.
If the setup fails, a tower keeps the lead growing and the dragon comes back in five minutes if they take it.
check: Which waves are pushed, is everyone alive with items bought, and is your Smite up?
breaks: Wrong if your team is carrying unspent gold: reset and buy before the spawn, even if you arrive a little later.
basis: pro:The lane that pushes first moves first

when: both teams have three dragons
asks: we both have three dragons
it's soul for either team, what do I do
double soul point, how do I play it
next dragon is soul for both of us
say: This dragon is soul for whoever gets it, so reset early and be there first as five, or look for a pick before it spawns.
more: Nothing else on the map is worth more right now, so every recall and wave should be timed around it.
The fight usually comes down to one Smite, so keeping their jungler away from the pit matters more than kills.
A pick beforehand is the clean way to win it without a coin toss.
check: How long until it spawns, is everyone alive and bought, and where is their jungler?
breaks: Wrong if a teammate dies before the spawn: stall at the entrance and wait for him rather than starting it four against five.
basis: rule

when: both enemy bot laners' item lists just changed and a dragon is up
asks: their bot just backed, dragon?
enemy bot lane recalled, what do I do
bot's in base, can we take drake
they both went back, objective?
say: Start dragon now with your bot lane while theirs walks back, or shove the wave for plates if you're too low to finish it.
more: New items mean they were just in base, so the two players nearest the pit are the furthest from it.
They return stronger than they left, so this only works if you start at once and leave when it is done.
Plates are the smaller, safer payment for the same window.
check: Is your bot lane still in lane and healthy, and where did their jungler last show?
breaks: Wrong if their jungler and mid are both unseen: they can reach the pit before the bot lane does, so take the plates instead.
basis: pro:Their jungler or carry in base is your window

when: kills and towers are close to even and a dragon is due within a minute
asks: game's even, do we fight for this dragon
even game, drake's coming
who wins the dragon fight
it's fifty fifty, contest or no
say: Fight for it if your mid and bot waves are pushed first, or give it and take top plates if you'd arrive second.
more: In an even game the dragon goes to whoever gets to the river first, and that is decided by the waves half a minute earlier.
Arriving second means walking through unwarded jungle into a team that is already set up.
Top plates or a tower while they take it keeps the game even instead of losing a fight as well.
check: Which mid and bot waves are pushed, and who is already walking to the river?
breaks: Wrong if it would be their third or fourth dragon: an even swap is not enough then, so go together and play for the Smite.
basis: pro:The lane that pushes first moves first
